structure.opening_style: Context-setting followed by a problem/solution hook
structure.section_organization: Logical progression with clear, descriptive headings
structure.code_integration: Strategic use of code blocks to demonstrate implementation, often accompanied by explanatory text
structure.conclusion_style: Summary of benefits with a clear call-to-action or link to documentation

communication.value_proposition: Emphasizes speed, simplicity, cost-efficiency, and unified governance
credibility_markers: References to specific customer success stories (e.g., Corning, Xcel Energy)
Usage of benchmarks and performance metrics (e.g., '7x faster', '20x query latency reduction')
Citations of internal research or open source contributions
communication.technical_depth: Deep but accessible; bridges high-level business value with low-level technical implementation
